query: PEM & AEM Electrolyzers for Green Hydrogen Projects Market

market_analysis.market_type_reason: B2B: the buyers are green hydrogen project developers, industrial hydrogen producers, captive industrial users and utilities.
market_analysis.market_definition: The PEM & AEM Electrolyzers for Green Hydrogen Projects Market refers to the sales of Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) and Anion Exchange Membrane (AEM) electrolyzers that use renewable electricity to split water into hydrogen and oxygen, producing green hydrogen. The market covers electrolyzer stacks and integrated systems deployed across industrial and commercial green hydrogen projects. By product: PEM electrolyzers, AEM electrolyzers. By configuration: electrolyzer stacks, integrated electrolyzer systems. By system capacity: below 1 MW, 1 MW to below 5 MW, 5 MW to below 20 MW, 20 MW and above. By application: green ammonia production, petroleum refining, iron & steel manufacturing, chemical manufacturing, energy storage & power, other industrial applications. By end user: green hydrogen project developers, industrial hydrogen producers, captive industrial users, utilities & energy companies. Geography: India -- companies HEADQUARTERED IN India.
market_analysis.core_scope: A core player is HEADQUARTERED IN India and itself makes and sells, under its own name, PEM (proton exchange membrane) or AEM (anion exchange membrane) water electrolyzers -- electrolyzer stacks or integrated electrolyzer systems -- for green hydrogen projects: own-technology developers, and Indian manufacturers that build and sell PEM / AEM stacks or systems under their own name (including under a technology licence). Diversified Indian groups qualify when PEM / AEM electrolyzers are one of their own product lines.
adjacent_segments: Makers of only alkaline water electrolyzers (AWE)
Makers of only solid oxide electrolyzers (SOEC)
Hydrogen storage, transportation and distribution companies (tanks, cylinders, pipelines, compressors, refuelling)
Grey, blue and brown hydrogen production equipment makers (steam methane reforming, coal gasification, carbon capture)
Green hydrogen project developers, industrial hydrogen producers, captive users and utilities that buy electrolyzers (the customers)
EPC contractors and plant integrators that do not make or sell their own PEM / AEM electrolyzer
Component and material suppliers only (membranes, catalysts, bipolar plates, power electronics)
Distributors, traders and Indian offices or subsidiaries of foreign electrolyzer makers
Research institutes and start-ups with no commercially sold PEM / AEM electrolyzer

market_participants.definition: Indian companies that make and sell PEM or AEM electrolyzer stacks or systems under their own name.
market_participants.why_relevant: They supply the electrolyzers the market is measured on.
